performance_limits: All successful, adverse and failed runs are retained. First two baseline attempts exposed QA route/freshness mistakes and are not measurements.
Initial candidate has higher live, correction and CPU costs; rejected as the broad default.
Direct existing D126 source-version read replaces a new B130 view and repeated global change polls on each live input.

Reverse candidate3/baseline4:4000-row warm265/471ms, maximum loop lag13.45/471.89ms; CPU641/542ms and correction294/5.5ms. Compact retention and responsiveness improve while CPU/live/correction costs can increase.
Default admission narrowed to at least2048 elapsed source rows. This measured cutoff is not a universal optimum.
Final default-mode run verifies selection and numeric hashes after integrating PR197; shared host load increased. Do not compare it as an isolated speedup against earlier runs.
Coarse source revision invalidates the entire prefix after a source write. Correction still performs a bounded rebuild; not a per-bar amendment optimization.
Memory estimates include retained prefix and owner slots; shared B130/history/cache budgets are separately accounted, not a whole-process RSS claim.
Real isolated SQLite with controlled input and actual DataManager/bridge/cache; no network during benchmarks. No fixed latency SLA.

native.assembly: Accepted PR197 runtime reused; current tracked backend/app already copied and byte-compiled with bundled Python. Current frontend built with VITE_DESKTOP_BUILD=1; app.asar repacked with existing production dependencies and current desktop files, integrity header updated, deep ad-hoc signed and strictly verified. Not a fresh full runtime build. Backend-only proven server-time reuse applied after attempt10 full owned process exit, byte-compiled with bundled Python and deep ad-hoc re-signed/strict verified; frontend unchanged.
native.backend_exception_review: One expected HTTP client-disconnect CancelledError from _run_until_request_disconnect after request work cancellation/drain; no other ERROR or traceback. Not zero backend logged exceptions.
native.cold_load_limit: Real public cold qualification took roughly7m23s from packaged launch to first prefix+value proof. This is functional acceptance, not a cold-load latency SLA or isolated performance improvement.
